# Solutions for Fall Agribusiness risks


## Fall Festivals, Trail Riding, & Crop Spraying:
Solutions for complex risks


With fall in full swing, your agribusiness accounts are handling everything from custom field spraying to crowded seasonal festivals. Kinsale delivers the specialized[Agribusiness Casualty](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/agribusiness/agribusiness-casualty/) and[Agribusiness Property](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/agribusiness/agribusiness-property/) solutions they need.


Whether the risk is big or small, straightforward or complex, you can make Kinsale your first call for solutions.


##### **Agribusiness Casualty**


**Coverages**


**Focus Classes**


- Commercial General Liability
- Pollution coverages available
- $1M/$2M/$2M with excess options available
- Occurrence & Claims-Made


- **Crop Spraying:** Custom farming and chemical application
- **Agritainment:** Pumpkin patches, corn mazes, haunted attractions, and seasonal farm events
- **Equine Exposures:** Trail riding and boarding
- **Animal Confinement:** Large-scale operations


[Explore More Target Classes](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/agribusiness/agribusiness-casualty/)


##### **Agribusiness Property**


**Coverages**


**Focus Classes**


- Commercial Property coverages
- $10M in total capacity
- **Ground-up:** TIV of $10M or less
- **Primary:** TIV up to $25M
- **Excess:** TIV up to $5B; larger risks considered case by case


- **Farm Equipment:** Combines, pivots, tractors, and other farming-related equipment
- **Greenhouses:** Commercial growers
- **Equine Facilities:** Stables and arenas
- **High-Risk Structures:** Wildfire-exposed buildings and older farm structures


[Explore More Target Classes](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/agribusiness/agribusiness-property/)


#### **Product Spotlight:**[Farm Equipment](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/agribusiness/agribusiness-property/#farm-equipment)


Our newest **Agribusiness Property** offering is built to protect the heavy machinery driving your clients’ businesses.


- **Broad Limits:** Written with total limits up to **$10M** ($1M maximum TIV per individual item)
- **Streamlined:** Consolidate combines, pivots, tractors, and specialized farm machinery under **one comprehensive policy**
